description.text: Objective This program combines the study of theories on pharmaceutical issues and intensive training in research technologies. The program is intended to provide students with strong scientific and technical backgrounds. The program is designed to prepare students for research and academic careers in pharmaceutical analysis, clinical application of new medicine, pharmaceutical administration, research, design, production and management of new medicine. Degree Requirements Students in this program spend the first 2 years studying the basic sciences, biology and chemistry courses. In the first semester of the 3rd Year of their undergraduate study, student must choose from different areas of concentration. Upon graduation, students must have completed core courses, lab courses, practicum and thesis writing. Fee Tuition25000 RMB Physical examination: 700RMB; Residence permit: 800RMB per year; Medical insurance: 800RMB per year; Books: around 3,000RMB for the first year (CMU will return the extra or charge more from the students according to the actual cost); Accommodation: around 7,000RMB per year for a single room. Biology & Chemistry Inorganic Chemistry;Analytical Chemistry;Organic Chemistry;Physical Chemistry;Biochemistry & Molecular Biology Main course Pharmaceutics;Pharmacology;Pharmacy Analysis;Clinical Pharmacology;Pharmacy Metabolism Kinetics;Survey of Modern Medicine;Pharmacy Spectral Analysis;PharmacyChromatography

duration.text: The Pharmacy at China Medical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated intoChinese or English and be notarized. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5. Sponsorship Certificate 6. HSK certificate

requirements.text: 1.Applicants are required to have graduated from High School. 2.Applicants must be at least 18 years of age at the start of the course. 3.Minimum English language requirement (IELTS 6.5 or above or IBT 90 or above)
